faq: Do I need Apple and Google developer accounts?

Yes, to publish. Apple charges a yearly fee and Google a one-time fee, both paid by you. We never ask for your passwords. You add us as a team member and we create builds and listings inside your own accounts.
Can you build from a sketch or a short idea?
Yes. Send notes, a sketch or an app you like. We turn it into a screen list and a feature list, and you approve both in writing before we write any code. Later changes use your revision rounds.
You do. The source code goes into your own repository from the first day, with build instructions. There are no licence fees, and any other developer can pick the project up later.
Can you promise App Store and Google Play approval?
No one can. Apple and Google decide on every release. We follow their rules, test the build properly and fix review feedback within your package, but we cannot promise a result or a review date.
